summary: Frontend-only verification of SHARE + SETTINGS feature batch. All share panels open with valid /s/<token> links across Thesis, KPI snapshot, KPI documents, Visual chart, Macro (trend + coef-history), Company (revenue-chart + ratio-history), and header page-share. Ajustes modal opens from renamed header button and hosts Moneda/Integraciones/Umbrales. Currency selector removed from header outside modal. Webhook Save rejects invalid host (422 → error toast), accepts discord.com URL and shows Configurado/Probar/Eliminar. Eliminar returns to no-webhook state (confirmed indirectly via Discord-unconfigured info toast). Public /s/<token> viewer renders share-view + download link + PDF iframe with no app header. Anonymous share nudge shows 'Inicia sesión para compartir' toast. All regression pages load with 0 pageerrors.

ui_bugs.issue: Panel opens with negative x (~-187px) so WhatsApp/Telegram/X/Facebook/Email/Discord/Slack buttons render OFF-SCREEN to the LEFT and are not clickable via normal mouse interaction. Functionality works when clicked via JS. Panel should be clamped to viewport (translateX to keep within window). thesis-share-panel bbox observed: {x:-187,y:346,w:290,h:230}.

A_ajustes_modal.note: data-testid="webhook-row-discord" and "webhook-row-slack" NOT found (count=0); however the inner input/save/status/test/clear testids are all present and functional. Row-wrapper testid appears to be missing per spec (minor).

B_integraciones.valid discord url: saved OK — webhook-status-discord, webhook-test-discord, webhook-clear-discord all appear
B_integraciones.Probar (fake webhook): 400 error toast shown gracefully (no crash, modal alive)
B_integraciones.Eliminar: returned to unconfigured (verified later by Discord-unconfigured info toast on thesis share)

C_thesis_share.discord unconfigured toast: 'Configura el webhook de Discord en Ajustes' (verified)

detailed_results.E_kpi_document_share: 2 kpi-file-share-<id>-btn found; first click opened panel with /s/ link ✓

G_macro_share.coef-history-expand-btn -> coef-history-: /s/ link ✓ (needs fresh page after previous modal)

detailed_results.I_page_share: page-share-btn -> page-share-panel with /s/ link ✓ (takes several seconds due to html2pdf)
detailed_results.K_anonymous_nudge: Removed vs:token, clicked page-share-btn on /kpis → toast 'Inicia sesión para compartir' shown, no crash ✓

action_items: MEDIUM: Clamp ShareMenu popover position within viewport — on /thesis/thesis_test_aidc the panel opens at x=-187 and its right-column buttons (WhatsApp/Telegram/X/Facebook/Email/Discord/Slack) are cut off to the left of the window. Consider using a right-anchored (dropdown-menu-right) layout when the trigger is near the left edge, or a position:fixed with clamped left = max(8, computed).
MINOR: Add data-testid="webhook-row-discord" and data-testid="webhook-row-slack" wrappers as specified (only inner testids are currently present).
critical_code_review_comments: ShareMenu popover has no viewport-edge collision handling; will overflow on any page where the share button sits close to the left/right edges of a container.

Modal cleanup between chart modals (trend vs coef-history, revenue-chart vs ratio-history) still requires a full page reload in tests — Escape sometimes doesn't propagate — consider explicit close buttons or a single-instance modal manager (already noted in iteration_32).

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (all 12 share flows + public viewer + anonymous nudge); 1 MEDIUM UI positioning bug

seed_data_creation: None (used seeded thesis_test_aidc, NVDA kpi_snapshot + kpi docs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All share panel testids resolve and contain a real /s/<token> URL. The only real bug is the ShareMenu popover overflowing left of the viewport when the trigger sits near the left edge (observed on /thesis/thesis_test_aidc thesis-share-btn — panel bbox x=-187). Functionality (click, copy, share intents, discord/slack info toast) works when interacted with programmatically. Public viewer /s/<token> renders share-view with download link and PDF iframe and no app chrome. Anonymous users get 'Inicia sesión para compartir' info toast. Webhook flow: invalid host → 422 error toast, valid discord.com URL → saved, Probar on fake URL → 400 error toast gracefully, Eliminar → back to unconfigured. Note: webhook-row-discord / webhook-row-slack wrapper testids missing but not blocking.
rca of the issue: ShareMenu likely uses absolute positioning relative to a small trigger container; when the trigger is aligned to the left of a card/section that also sits at the left edge of the main content, the absolutely-positioned popover ends up with negative left. Fix: add boundary detection (window.innerWidth) or use a floating-ui/radix Popover with collisionBoundary=viewport, or default to right-anchored placement when triggerRect.left < panelWidth.
